parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: OperateTaskId
parameters.description:
The ID of the task generated by a handling operation.
> You can call the [OperateVirusEvents](~~OperateVirusEvents~~) operation to handle alerts and generate this parameter.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query.
